title: Security audit: verify credentials not persisted
description: Perform a security audit to verify database credentials are never persisted to disk or browser storage and are cleared on session end.
acceptanceCriteria: No credentials found in localStorage or sessionStorage
No credentials found in IndexedDB or cookies

evidence: commit: d00ce73 - TASK-049: security audit report verifying credentials not persisted (pushed to origin/ticket/TASK-049)
Report: reports/security/TASK-049-credential-persistence-audit.md (new) — all 5 acceptance criteria PASS, risk rating Low

Static analysis (host grep of source, no host tools): grep for localStorage/sessionStorage/indexedDB/document.cookie/fs.write* across src/ and frontend/src/ — no production-code matches; credentials exist only in React state (useConnection.ts) and a module variable (credential-store.ts), plus transient fetch request bodies

Unit tests (node:20-alpine, ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run): root src/ 26 files / 328 tests passed 0 failed — incl. src/__tests__/useConnection.test.ts 17 tests (3 session-clearing); frontend/ 4 files / 13 tests passed 0 failed — incl. src/services/credential-store.test.ts 7 tests (in-memory-only, no localStorage/sessionStorage writes)

E2E (mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.49.1-noble, Chromium; app served by nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:1.27-alpine on private --internal network qa-TASK-049, never on host): npx playwright@1.49.1 test e2e/credential-clearing.spec.ts — 2 passed 0 failed (form visible; credentials cleared on page reload, new connection required)

Secret scanning (zricethezav/gitleaks:v8.18.2, --no-git, source only): 2 matches both false positives (password_type == "password" string comparisons in git-ignored QA artifact and a report describing that false positive), 0 real secrets/credentials in source code
